# Suite: hand-drawn GSAP page transition for websites

Suite draw, swell and reveal transition. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents.

[![Suite: hand-drawn GSAP page transition for websites](demo/preview.jpg)](https://loouis.github.io/skills/gsap-transition-suite/demo/)

[Open the live demo](https://loouis.github.io/skills/gsap-transition-suite/demo/) · [Demo source](demo/index.html) · [Demo prompt](demo/PROMPT.md) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [References](REFERENCES.md)

## What it does

Build the Suite hand-drawn GSAP page transition. One broad S-curve rolls from top to bottom. Use when the user asks for Suite, the wave transition, or this named draw-swell-cover-reveal effect on a website. Ships reusable curves, adaptive portrait fronts, a covered routing lifecycle and a working demo.

## Use it

- **Claude Code**: copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/gsap-transition-suite/` (or run `python3 install.py` from the repository root), then ask in your own words or call `/gsap-transition-suite`.
- **Codex**: copy this folder into your Codex skills directory and ask: "Use $gsap-transition-suite to add the Suite page transition to this site."
- **Other agents**: point the agent at [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) and let it follow the steps.

**Tags:** GSAP · page transitions · route transitions · SVG · web animation · Astro · Barba.js
